#!/bin/bash
# Sentinel completion checker for c2_n500 profiling experiments
BASE=/root/autodl-tmp/pacs
TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

DS_DONE=0
DS_TOTAL=8
QW_DONE=0
QW_TOTAL=8

DS_CONDITIONS=(
    "profiling_output_n500_bf16_ds_imp_s015"
    "profiling_output_n500_bf16_ds_imp_s020"
    "profiling_output_n500_bf16_ds_imp_s025"
    "profiling_output_n500_bf16_ds_imp_s030"
    "profiling_output_n500_bf16_ds_rand_s015"
    "profiling_output_n500_bf16_ds_rand_s020"
    "profiling_output_n500_bf16_ds_rand_s025"
    "profiling_output_n500_bf16_ds_rand_s030"
)

QW_CONDITIONS=(
    "profiling_output_n500_bf16_qw_imp_s015"
    "profiling_output_n500_bf16_qw_imp_s020"
    "profiling_output_n500_bf16_qw_imp_s025"
    "profiling_output_n500_bf16_qw_imp_s030"
    "profiling_output_n500_bf16_qw_rand_s015"
    "profiling_output_n500_bf16_qw_rand_s020"
    "profiling_output_n500_bf16_qw_rand_s025"
    "profiling_output_n500_bf16_qw_rand_s030"
)

echo "[$TIMESTAMP] === Completion Check ==="

echo "DeepSeek conditions:"
for cond in "${DS_CONDITIONS[@]}"; do
    if [ -f "$BASE/$cond/profiling_results.json" ]; then
        DS_DONE=$((DS_DONE + 1))
        echo "  [DONE] $cond"
    else
        echo "  [    ] $cond"
    fi
done

echo "Qwen conditions:"
for cond in "${QW_CONDITIONS[@]}"; do
    if [ -f "$BASE/$cond/profiling_results.json" ]; then
        QW_DONE=$((QW_DONE + 1))
        echo "  [DONE] $cond"
    else
        echo "  [    ] $cond"
    fi
done

echo "Summary: DeepSeek $DS_DONE/$DS_TOTAL, Qwen $QW_DONE/$QW_TOTAL"

if [ "$DS_DONE" -eq "$DS_TOTAL" ] && [ ! -f "$BASE/DONE_DEEPSEEK" ]; then
    echo "$TIMESTAMP" > "$BASE/DONE_DEEPSEEK"
    echo ">>> SENTINEL: Created DONE_DEEPSEEK"
fi

if [ "$QW_DONE" -eq "$QW_TOTAL" ] && [ ! -f "$BASE/DONE_QWEN" ]; then
    echo "$TIMESTAMP" > "$BASE/DONE_QWEN"
    echo ">>> SENTINEL: Created DONE_QWEN"
fi

if [ "$DS_DONE" -eq "$DS_TOTAL" ] && [ "$QW_DONE" -eq "$QW_TOTAL" ] && [ ! -f "$BASE/DONE_ALL_N500" ]; then
    echo "$TIMESTAMP" > "$BASE/DONE_ALL_N500"
    echo ">>> SENTINEL: Created DONE_ALL_N500"
fi

echo ""
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/autodl-tmp/pacs/check_completion.sh
